title: Dolmens tied to a cult of giants

tellings.quote: Um and I believe that the dolmans are associated with the giants, not just because they're large stones, but they're associated with the cult of giants.

plain: Dolmens are ancient monuments made of large upright stones topped by a flat slab. According to a guest named Tim Alberino, the ones on Sardinia, Minorca and elsewhere are tied to a cult of giants, and not only because the stones are huge. Alberino tells Michels this as his own belief, without naming a source, in an episode about giants.
